reviews.x: My daughter wore these to Disney and we had so many compliments.  She is 2 and won't keep real Minnie ears on and these were a great alternative.  HIGHLY recommend!!!

Very cute. The only thing I didn't like was the oversized alligator clips used. I feel they should have been on smaller sized clips. They fell out often. I'll probably try to remove them and convert them to a smaller clip myself.
I actually used these to Minney up my backpack at Disneyland. I got a ton of compliments! Just be careful the material is thin
Love love these little clips, I find that the big bows sometimes hurt my head but these here were perfect solution.
Perfect for smaller babies that hate things like headbands on their heads. They were well made and super cute!
we love them better that the ears headband... they stay in place no matter if she’s running or jumping.

I bought these for hair clips for an adult to wear to disneyworld. I cannot speak to how well they would work for a baby, but based on the style of the clip I would question that purpose. (They do include an elastic string in the package, but I doubt that would hold up.) HOWEVER, if you are an adult or have a child with full grown hair, these clips are awesome! They're super cute (and surprisingly well made for the price). I like that you can place them where you want and I think they'll be more

Bought this for a photo shoot with my daughter and they worked PERFECT!! They're exactly what I wanted!! They looked super cute and they're so cute she will be wearing them with her Minnie outfit on a regular day! Could be used as part of a costume if you wanted too!! Super adorable! Extremely happy with my purchase!

Super cute ! Bought these in hopes my 1 year old would keep on longer then her head bands. And she did! she wore them almost the whole day until her nap time at 4! Love , love these! She received so many compliments all day ! Great solution to my daily struggle with head pieces.

Cute idea. They hold well in my daughter's hair, but that silver clip that they use is horrendous and it clearly shows because of how large it is. Yuck! Then, the bow is pretty ugly. The white dots looked like they were drawn on with an opaque white paint marker so they are awkward looking. I will be fixing them myself, but they are not good quality in my opinion. They sell the same thing at the park for $9.99 and I'd rather pay a bit more to get a higher quality.

These ears are cute. I look forward to wearing them to Disneyland this summer! I was happy to find these, because I like to wear ears to the parks but the headbands give me a headache and the hats are too hot. As an adult woman, these are a tad on the small side but I'm going to use them anyway. For a child, these would work perfectly!

reviews.t: Fun and can be used by adults
reviews.x: Bought these to wear to Disneyland as an adult and they were perfect. I wore them with a black visor https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B007P4EUUU/ref=mp_s_a_1_15?ie=UTF8&qid=1483573469&sr=8-15&pi=AC_SX236_SY340_QL65&keywords=black+visor+women and the look turned out great! Super cute! The clips are durable and easy to use also.

Bought these because typical headbands give me headaches. I was pleasantly surprised when I received them. They are of a great quality and I can’t wait to wear them to Disney in December. They are also super secure. My husband and I go every year and these will be in my luggage for every trip in the future.

I used these to do my 7 year olds hair for our trip to Disney world and they were so cute! I loved these because we didn’t have to worry about them falling out or annoying her like the headbands do. We actually had quite a few people asking us where we got them because they looked so cute.

It came in great! It's not felt but more of a stretch fabric which is really cute. Bought it for my two year old to go to Disneyland and it's a great option instead of a Mickey hat or headband. The bow on one ear was crooked but I don't mind since it's for my littles.

I added little sunflowers to my ears because of my baby's theme. but they hold great, didnt fall stayed on the whole party.  1year later and my daughter continues to use these ears. she has used them to go to the parks and when it matches her outfit. still look great.

We got these for our 18-month-old daughter for her very first trip to Disneyland. She loved wearing them and didn't put them at all. We received so many compliments while in the park. Everyone wanted to know where they could buy them.
Super cute and perfect for my toddler who will NOT keep a headband on!

reviews.t: Very happy with this purchase so far
reviews.x: Very happy with this purchase so far...the only thing I'm a little uneasy about are the clips themselves. Just a little upset that they arrived crooked and bent, but they will work for her birthday party! If anything I will end up attaching my own clips for her for future use. I don't think that the clips are too big, I just don't think they will last too long. Overall, I would definitely buy these again. They are super cute, and you can't beat the price. Hope this helps :)

When I received these I immediately realized that the ears were on opposite ends of one another rather than the picture of the item.  When I looked at the ears themselves there was a gap in the material where they are attached, I am adding two photos as examples.  We already went to Disney so I am sending back, don't know if it was a fluke but was not satisfied with my purchase.

These ear clips are cute and lightweight but not very comfortable. My daughter did complain that the clips were bothering her head and they kept moving unless tied with something else or having a specific hairstyle. Pic 3 shows the comparison with Disney's own ear clips which are slightly more expensive but fuller and stay in place on the head. Overall they are okay

reviews.t: I loved these. Nice change from just an original Minnie ...
reviews.x: I loved these.  Nice change from just an original Minnie Mouse headband.  The only thing I can say is the prongs hurt my daughter as I slid them into her ponytail.  Maybe if it was just a smooth clip instead.  Still a good product.

claims.text: Customers widely praise these as a cute, comfortable alternative to headbands and hats, especially for Disney trips.
Many reviewers report receiving compliments and say the clips stay in place well, even on active children.
Several customers note the clips are oversized or the material is thin, with some reporting they fall out or look awkward.
Some reviewers question the clips' suitability for babies and note the bows run small for adults.
A few customers mention quality issues like crooked bows or poorly done white dots.
